summary: Husband of Angela Carrozzino and father of Giovanni Pasquale DiBiasi; John's maternal 4th-great-grandfather.
bio: Domenico Di Biase was born about 1789. With his wife Angela Carrozzino he was the father of Giovanni Pasquale DiBiasi, which makes him John's 4th-great-grandfather on his mother's side. His birthplace has been given as Lucera in the province of Foggia, but this is doubtful: the family belonged to Guardia Lombardi in Avellino, and the Lucera claim rests on nothing firm.

researchNotes: Tree: Domenico Di Biase (b. 1789) + Angela Carrozzino, parents of Giovanni P. Dibiasi. A record thumbnail on Domenico appears to mention Lucera?, Foggia (unconfirmed). Round 1 judged this probably attached to the wrong man: the family was from Guardia Lombardi (Avellino), whose records are at AS Avellino, while Lucera holds a Sezione di Archivio di Stato for Foggia-province records and Di Biase is a common Capitanata surname. Round 2 found the 'Lucera' claim on the FS tree profiles of his son and daughter-in-law with zero sources; remove Lucera. Speculative until the image is checked: verify whether the record's comune is Guardia Lombardi.
